incident-bot: PAGER: sev=P1 cluster=ryzen-gpu prefills failing - repeated container restarts (OOM). Alert: 1923456789. Symptoms: high 5xx rate from /v1/chat (prefill stage).
carla.sre: ack — oncall here, looking. Can someone post affected pods + node?
josh.runtime: seeing repeated CUDA OOM during prefill on pods in pool `prefill-rt-8g`. Kernel trace snippet from pod gpu-rt-199: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:07Z] runtime.cpp:prefill() ERROR cudart: out of memory when allocating 3355443200 bytes (alloc_idx=1)
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'c10::OutOfMemoryError'
Aborted (core dumped)
```
carla.sre: thanks. kube output (short): 
```
$ kubectl get pods -n redwood | grep prefill-rt-8g
prefill-rt-8g-199   CrashLoopBackOff   1/1  48m
prefill-rt-8g-205   Running            0/1  7m
```
deploy-bot: rolling-update triggered: cordon node gpu-node-12; evicting pods on node gpu-node-12 as part of mitigation.
priya.platform: quick ask — are these long-context customer requests? any correlation to request size?
josh.runtime: yes. Logs show prefill token counts > 12k for several requests. Our prefill allocation path assumes max 8k and allocations blow past GPU mem for larger contexts (esp. when kv cache + model weights + temp activations).
miguel.support: seeing customer errors: telemetry shows spike in 502/503 for customer orgs: "finsearch" and "docuassist" starting ~14:10 UTC. Approx 6% of traffic hitting hosted endpoint failing.
emma.custsuc: prepping a short customer note; hold until we have mitigation ETA.
carla.sre: mitigation plan (short): 1) apply temporary gateway hard cap on prefill tokens to 6k for hosted endpoints, returning 413 for larger requests; 2) enable fallback routing to quantized-variant (q4) for prefill pool to lower memory footprint; 3) cordon problematic node and drain; 4) restart prefills with reduced PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS env var. Doing 1 + 2 now.
josh.runtime: deploying patch to runtime config: set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=6000 and PREFILL_QUANT_FALLBACK=true in configmap redwood-runtime-prefill (will trigger rolling restart). Command: 
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/prefill-rt PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=6000 -n redwood
kubectl patch configmap redwood-runtime --patch '{"data":{"prefill_policy":"quant_fallback"}}' -n redwood
```
carla.sre: applied PATCH, rolling restart in progress. Monitor logs.
deploy-bot: configmap patched by josh.runtime at 1923456952. Rolling restart 6/12 pods restarted.
josh.runtime: early signs: pods coming up with smaller memory footprint. Preflight log for a large request now shows prefill truncation to 6k tokens rather than attempting full prefill.
```
[2026-03-15T14:18:30Z] runtime.cpp:prefill() INFO truncating request: requested=12100 capped=6000
[2026-03-15T14:18:31Z] allocator.cpp INFO reserved=1.9GB resident=2.1GB
```
miguel.support: error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2% over last 6 minutes for affected orgs. Customers still seeing degraded latency for truncated requests.
emma.custsuc: sending heads-up to "finsearch" / "docuassist" w/ recommended workaround (split large docs into multiple requests) — draft sent to legal review.
priya.platform: longer-term next steps: add server-side prefill streaming (so we can prefill in chunks), improve per-request memory accounting, and add model-level config for max_kv_cache_alloc. Filing follow-up ticket.
carla.sre: immediate action: continue monitoring for 30m. If stable, will move to postmortem. Handoff note: my shift ends in 25m; pinging next on-call. @priya.platform are you able to take over?
priya.platform: I can take the handoff. Summary for handoff: root cause = unbounded prefill token sizes (some customer requests >12k) hitting mem assumptions, runtime would allocate large KV cache during prefill causing CUDA OOM -> container restart. Temporary mitigation = gateway hard cap (6000 tokens) + quantized fallback to reduce memory per-token. Next actions = postmortem, permanent config to enforce prefill accounting, and GA-safe warning for customers.
carla.sre: passing pager to priya.platform at 1923458750. Leaving handler notes in pager system.
josh.runtime: added logs/alert rule to flag sustained prefill allocations > 7.5k tokens; added unit tests to ensure allocator fails gracefully without aborting process.
miguel.support: will update status page: "We identified an issue causing prefill memory errors for very large context requests. We've applied a temporary limit and are restoring service; customers may see truncated responses for very large prompts. Engineering is working on a permanent fix." Posting in 5m.
emma.custsuc: capturing impacted customer list and sending individual reach-outs for paid customers.
carla.sre: marking incident as mitigated at 1923460300 (reduced error rate, rolling restarts completed). We'll run RCA + postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
priya.platform: acknowledged takeover. We'll schedule follow-ups: postmortem owner josh.runtime, action items to track in infra board.
incident-bot: Incident state change: mitigated -> triage continued. Incident ID: INC-20260315-01.
carla.sre: thanks team. Leaving final note: do not change PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS without coordination — it's a temporary mitigation.
